Case: Elvia is a 29-year-old metastatic medulloblastoma status-post multiple rounds of chemotherapy and radiation therapy, presenting with several months of progressive leg pain. Elvia describes the pain as sometimes crampy and other times sharp, involving different regions of both her legs at different times. In addition to her deconditioning, she is now unable to sleep due to constant pain. On physical examination, you detect diffuse bilateral lower extremity weakness with intact sensation.
